newsitem.title: USA: Continental American declares stock div.
newsitem.headline: Continental American declares stock div.

text.p: Continental American Transportation Inc said Tuesday it approved a stock dividend in its holdings of Bio-Dyne Corp to its shareholders of record on a one for one basis.
The shares of Bio-Dyne have been segregated for future distribution to its shareholders of record as of July 7, a news release issued by Continental said.
Shareholders of record will receive the equivalent of one share of Bio-Dyne for each share of Continental owned, the news release said.
A distribution date has not been set but is expected during the next few months, the news release said.
Continental owns controlling interest in Bio-Dyne Corp Inc, a supplier of exercise and weight lifting equipment based in Atlanta.
Continental is a trucking and logistics management company with operating subsidiaries engaged in the transportation of food, beverages and textiles.
